audit.whatIsWrong: Not one Zaahen ability is named anywhere on the page - it says 'his Q', 'his combo', 'his key spell' and, repeatedly, 'Ultimate'. The single most important interaction is therefore absent: Aureate Rush deals damage scaled to the target's maximum health, which is the exact stat Cho'Gath spends the game stacking.
audit.why: Aureate Rush carries the percentHealth flag ('punishes HP stacking - armour alone is not the answer'), so every Feast stack increases what his dash hits you for. Dreaded Return is an 850-range pull, which is the engage the page tells you to silence without ever saying what it is. The Darkin Glaive is an auto-attack reset that heals, with a recast that knocks up. Cultivation of War lets him revive once filled.
audit.corrected: Named all five: Cultivation of War, The Darkin Glaive, Dreaded Return, Aureate Rush, Grim Deliverance - and wrote the percent-health and revive interactions in.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Cho'Gath levels 2 and 3, but the page's own whys say 'Zaahen takes level 2' and 'level 3 flattens to skill'.
audit.why: The chart disagreed with the prose at exactly those two stages, and the packet chart matches the prose. A 48.69% win rate over 799 games is the largest sample in this slice and supports a lane Cho'Gath loses early and wins on items.
audit.corrected: Skill / Zaahen / Skill / Skill / Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath with ratings 5,4,5,5,5,6,6. EVEN 6/10 stands.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike referred to an unnamed 'Ultimate' with no cooldown.
audit.why: His real curve is The Darkin Glaive 10 down to 6s, Aureate Rush 10 down to 8s, Dreaded Return 14 down to 12s and Grim Deliverance 110/95/80s. The ultimate is the least frequent thing in his kit, so building the whole page around tracking it was the wrong anchor.
audit.corrected: Track Dreaded Return's 14 seconds as the engage, and treat Grim Deliverance as a 110-second heal rather than the thing that decides trades.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is never mentioned, and neither is the fact that health stacking backfires here.
audit.why: The Darkin Glaive heals on use and Grim Deliverance heals for a portion of the damage dealt, so Grievous Wounds decides extended trades. Meanwhile Aureate Rush scales off your max health, so the usual Cho'Gath answer of more HP makes his dash hit harder.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds early; resistances and Feast stacks are not a complete answer against Aureate Rush.

notes: Zaahen is absent from the packet's enemyAbilities (it is null for this row), so the name checker could not flag anything here - which is exactly why the page had no ability names at all. The kit file champ-data/_kits/zaahen.json does exist and is Data Dragon 16.15.1, so everything above comes from it. Its Q lists range 25000 and E lists 25000, which look like placeholder values rather than real ranges; I did not quote either. His passive revive is stated in Riot's text but the conditions ('when filled with Determination') are not quantified, so I wrote it as a caution, not a timer. Also: chogath.json tags Rupture with grounding, a tooltip-parse misfire on 'Ruptures the ground' (same on Malphite Q and Olaf Q), so I wrote Rupture's knockup against his dash, not grounding.
